en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a Renaissance-style building with an arcaded courtyard. The building has ornate arches and stone balustrades on multiple levels surrounding an open courtyard. On the left, there is a chapel or turret. The image is labeled with 'Graz Landhausshof' in red letters in the upper right corner, and publisher information 'Stengel & Co., Dresden u. Berlin 4712' in the lower right.
